name: Brackeys Cut the Rope Replica

description: Cut the Rope replica prototype created during Brackeys’ “How to make a CUT THE ROPE Replica in Unity (Livestream Tutorial)” tutorial on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dx3jb4muLjQ&list=PLPV2KyIb3jR5RwVEjFCiN5BvK3Quqgv_M&index=10 . Cut the rope by clicking the left mouse button anywhere on a rope connector. Try to get the ball into the bucket!
